text: PR #6502 (#5631 JSON NULL logical fix) and PR #6503 (#5567 deleted-flag import fix) both merged, issues closed. Filed and opened PR #6505 for #6047 (nullable-field _NullFlags on-disk storage support): CREATE TABLE/CURSOR NULL-clause fields now persist a real bit via a hidden _NullFlags bitmap field (byte layout recovered from real VFP9 9.0 SP2 under Wine, docs/80), REPLACE WITH .NULL. sets/clears it (fixed a separate bug where buffered NULL writes were silently discarded pre-TABLEUPDATE()), COPY STRUCTURE EXTENDED's FIELD_NULL now reports real nullability. Scope deliberately storage-layer only per owner direction -- filed #6506 as a follow-up for the larger PrgValue/VARTYPE()/EMPTY()/NVL()/EVL()/aggregate-on-NULL semantics redesign this surfaced. PR #6505 CI running now. #6496 (migration fidelity coverage) is next once #6505 lands.
